proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#14
proposed.text: The Superior returns in an android body, now working for General Hale, and threatens to bring down the Zephyr unless Coulson hands her over. Coulson gives in and leaves with them to keep his team safe.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Blames Coulson for his comrades' execution. Returns to free Hale and take Coulson away.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The agent the Superior blames for his comrades' deaths, who leaves with him and Hale.

changes.evidence: In The Devil Complex (S5#14) the Superior, now Hale's enforcer in an LMD body, boards the Zephyr with Creel, demands Hale's release and threatens to have the plane blown up; Coulson agrees to go with Hale to keep his agents safe and the Superior orders him to mask up and hand over his prosthetic hand. A new alliance (with Hale) and a direct hostage turn between them.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#12
proposed.text: Sif returns to Earth with no memory, and Coulson helps her get it back. When she learns Skye is an Inhuman she tries to take her to Asgard, then agrees to leave her with Coulson along with a warning.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An Asgardian warrior Coulson helps twice. Leaves Skye with him, with a warning.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The agent who helps Sif twice and keeps Skye on Earth despite her warning.

changes.evidence: In Who You Really Are (S2#12) Coulson finds the amnesiac Sif and promises to help her; when Skye's quake powers show, Sif thrusts her sword through the Vault D barrier to take Skye to Asgard, then agrees to let her stay and warns Coulson of the danger before leaving.

proposed.title: Loki S2#4
proposed.text: Sylvie enchants a TVA agent to get close to Renslayer, then takes her Time Stick and prunes her.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A variant Renslayer arrested as a child, who later prunes her.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The judge who arrested Sylvie as a child, whom Sylvie prunes.

changes.evidence: In Heart of the TVA (Loki S2#4) Hunter X-05 pulls Renslayer aside and is revealed to be enchanted by Sylvie, who takes the Time Stick and prunes Renslayer; Renslayer wakes in the Void in S2#6. A death-like end between them with no stage.

proposed.title: Jessica Jones S1#8
proposed.text: Alisa Jones is Jessica's mother. She is in the car with the family when it crashes on a road trip, leaving Jessica without her family.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Alisa's daughter, in the car when the family crashes.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Jessica's mother, lost in the family's car crash.

changes.evidence: Alisa appears in the S1#8 (AKA WWJD?) flashbacks of the Jones family car crash, with Jessica in the car. A real flashback, so the family tie is on screen from S1#8, well before the S2#7 stage.

proposed.title: Jessica Jones S2#13
proposed.text: After Alisa escapes prison, Jessica goes on the run with her mother. At Playland, Trish shoots Alisa dead in front of Jessica.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Alisa's daughter, who goes on the run with her and sees her shot dead.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Jessica's mother, who goes on the run with her until Trish shoots her dead.

changes.evidence: After the S2#7 stage: Jessica turns Alisa in (S2#9), Alisa escapes and takes Jessica in a stolen RV (S2#12), they plan to flee together, and in AKA Playland (S2#13) Trish shoots Alisa in the head on the Ferris wheel in front of Jessica. A death is a stage; none exists.

proposed.title: Jessica Jones S2#10
proposed.text: Trish visits Alisa in prison. Alisa blames Trish's IGH investigation for every killing she has done and says she should have killed her when she had the chance.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Jessica's sister, whose IGH investigation Alisa blames for her killings.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Jessica's mother, a killer who blames Trish for her crimes.

changes.evidence: Their enmity starts before the only stage (S2#13): in AKA Pork Chop (S2#10) Trish visits Alisa at the detention center, Alisa says Trish is the reason for every murder she committed and threatens to strangle her; in S2#12 Alisa breaks into Trish's hospital room to kill her. The S2#13 stage's 'Alisa comes to blame Trish' is this S2#10 scene.

now.title: Jessica Jones S2#7
now.text: Will Simpson learns that the IGH killer may go after Trish Walker and tries to protect her. The killer tracks him down at the Greenpoint Stages and kills him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A man trying to protect Trish from her. She kills him.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The killer Simpson tries to warn Trish about, who kills him.

changes.evidence: Simpson is killed by Alisa at the Greenpoint Stages in AKA Freak Accident (S2#2), after Trish ties him up there; he appears only as a mention from S2#3 on. S2#7 is wrong.

owner_calls.question: Saunders and Fisk never share a scene. Keep the connection as boss, then enemy, or drop it?
options: Keep: Saunders serves on Fisk's task force and his key card lets Daredevil free Fisk's Red Hook prisoners
Drop: they never meet; serving in Fisk's task force is sharing a crew
owner_calls.evidence: In S1#9 Saunders only patrols with Burt (no scene with Fisk, so 'picked him' is not shown); in S2#3 he gives Daredevil and Karen his Red Hook key card and begs Daredevil to stop Fisk, and Daredevil frees Fisk's prisoners; in S2#6 Powell kills him after a call from Cashman. Fisk never appears with him or names him on screen.
